text: Cue Skills DSH Bundle 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Cue 集成组合包，可将文档解析和公开数据查询接入 DSH。它通过 MCP 客户端注册 Omni Reader 与多个 Cue 数据域，提供网页和本地文档解析、解析结果读取，以及监管、宏观、披露、法律等公开数据查询。适合需要在 DSH 会话中调用 Cue 研究能力的用户；使用前需配置 CUE_API_KEY，本地文件访问范围可由 OMNI_ALLOWED_ROOTS 指定。

Cue Skills DSH Bundle connects Cue MCP services to DeepSeek Harness. It adds Omni Reader for web and authorized local document parsing, plus public data services for regulatory, macro, disclosure, and legal research. Configure CUE_API_KEY; OMNI_ALLOWED_ROOTS limits local file access.

Cue Skills DSH Bundle 的功能「Cue 公开数据查询」：将监管、宏观、披露、法律等 Cue 数据域作为 MCP 服务接入 DSH。用户可在会话中调用服务提供的研究数据工具，连接地址按数据域分别配置。
Cue Skills DSH Bundle 的功能「多数据域接入」：把多个 Cue 公开数据 MCP endpoint 注册到同一 profile，覆盖监管、市场、机构、实体、学术和 IPO 等主题，供 DSH 中的工具调用使用。
Cue Skills DSH Bundle 的功能「本地读取范围配置」：启动 Omni Reader 时可通过 OMNI_ALLOWED_ROOTS 设置允许访问的目录；未设置时使用 DSH 当前工作目录作为根路径。
Cue Skills DSH Bundle 使用前须知：数据 MCP 服务连接到 mcp.cuecue.cn，并通过 CUE_API_KEY 授权；查询内容会交由远程数据服务处理。

text: @cueai/dsh-cue-skills README · DSH bundles：This repo also ships [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-harness) **bundles** under [`dsh/`](./dsh) — thin composition packages that wire a Cue MCP server into a DSH profile so its tools surface natively (e.g. `mcp__omni__parse`). A skill is agent-loadable *instructions*; a bundle is a *composition package* (`package.json` + `cordis.patch.yml`) for the Harness. Install one with `dsh plugin --profile web add <pkg>`; see [`dsh/README.md`](./dsh) and the [`cue-omni-reader` bundle](./dsh/cue-omni-reader).

@cueai/dsh-cue-skills README · Repo-root bundle：The repository root is itself a DSH bundle (`package.json` declaring `dsh.bundle.patch` → [`cordis.patch.yml`](./cordis.patch.yml)), so one command wires the whole Cue surface — the Omni Reader MCP server plus the Cue public data domains — into a profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:sensedeal/cue-skills#<commit>
```

@cueai/dsh-cue-skills README · Repo-root bundle：Registries that install a repository as a DSH bundle (for example [skillhub.cn](https://skillhub.cn/plugins)) accept a repo only when this root manifest exists; the per-capability bundles under [`dsh/`](./dsh) stay available for narrower installs, and the optional SSRF/consent guard is deliberately **not** part of the repo-root bundle because it fails closed on local files.

@cueai/dsh-cue-skills README · What is Cue / What is a buddy：[Cue](https://cuecue.cn) is a **Deep Research Agent + Intelligence Sentinel** platform for high-precision finance and business workflows. It picks tools from 300+ professional data sources (A-share / HK / US equity disclosures, fund AMAC registries, business registries, court records, regulatory feeds, sell-side research, capital flow data), cross-validates findings across sources, and produces structured, source-cited reports in minutes instead of hours.
section: What is Cue / What is a buddy

text: @cueai/dsh-cue-skills README · What is Cue / What is a buddy：A **"buddy" (搭子)** is a research playbook for a specific scenario — corporate-credit pre-diligence, public-record compliance snapshot, quarterly earnings review, private-fund manager DD, etc. — defined once and reused by supplying the subject. The `cue-buddy` skill in this repo is what business experts use to author these playbooks conversationally.
section: What is Cue / What is a buddy

text: @cueai/dsh-cue-skills README · What is Cue / What is a buddy：> **Scope boundary**: Cue's tool surface covers public data sources only (equity disclosures / business registries / court records / regulatory filings / capital flows / etc.). Scenarios requiring private data (real AML on bank-internal transactions, medical diagnosis, internal accounting) are **not appropriate** as Cue buddies — the supervisor cannot route them and falls back to generic web search. `cue-buddy +author` flow calls `+capabilities` to cross-check each declared evidence source against the actual catalog before persisting a template.

@cueai/dsh-cue-skills README · Using a skill：`cue-buddy` is self-contained: an entrypoint `SKILL.md`, supporting `references/`, and stdlib-only `scripts/`. `cue-research` is **self-contained too** — it vendors the shared Cue client (`cue_api` / `sse_report` / `paths`) in its own `scripts/`, so it runs standalone (no sibling `cue-buddy` required).

Preferred install is at the top of this README (`npx skills add`). The `skills` CLI lists every skill; `--skill` picks one.

@cueai/dsh-cue-skills README · Using a skill：**Manual install**: copy the skill folder into `~/.claude/skills/` (Claude Code) or reference it via `/use-skill <path>`; other agents load `<skill>/SKILL.md` as a system instruction. Each skill is self-contained — `cue-buddy`/`cue-research` vendor their runtime, `cue-omni-reader`/`cue-data-mcp` are thin instruction layers.

@cueai/dsh-cue-skills README · Using a skill：**`cue-omni-reader`** ships no runtime parser scripts. Load its `SKILL.md` and connect an official Omni MCP surface. Existing URL tools need no local install; local files use the audited Bridge after minimum-root confirmation.

**`cue-data-mcp`** ships no runtime code. Load its `SKILL.md` and let the agent discover the live data domains from the anonymous `/api/mcp-catalog`, then connect through each domain's routing DTO. Self-contained: no sibling folders required.

@cueai/dsh-cue-skills README · Using a skill：The **`playbook/`** scene skills delegate the actual research run to `cue-research`'s runner. `cue-research` is self-contained (it vendors the shared Cue client), so install `playbook/<scene>` + `cue-research` as siblings under the same parent dir; `cue-buddy` is only needed if you also want to author or save buddies.

@cueai/dsh-cue-skills README · Using a skill：> **Credit grant to start**: every Cue account gets **500 credits on signup, plus 10 more each day**. Once you apply for an API key (sign in via the `cue` CLI) you can start — data queries and initial research draw from this grant, and each deep-research run still consumes credits, so the skills always confirm with you before spending.
